questions.stem: 相較於真相，假新聞在社群媒體上傳得快多了，往往幾小時內就傳到成千上萬人。
questions.answer: Compared with the truth, fake news spreads much faster on social media, often reaching thousands of people within a few hours.
accepted_answers: Compared to the truth, fake news travels far more quickly on social media, often reaching tens of thousands of people within hours.
Compared with the truth, false news spreads much faster on social media, often reaching thousands of people in just a few hours.

questions.stem: 轉傳資訊前先用批判性思考是很重要的，因為假新聞很容易誤導大眾，引發恐慌。
questions.answer: It is important to use critical thinking before forwarding any information, because fake news can easily mislead the public, causing panic.
accepted_answers: It is important to think critically before passing on any information, since fake news can easily mislead the public, causing panic.
It is essential to apply critical thinking before sharing information, because fake news can easily mislead the public, leading to panic.

patterns: 虛主詞 It is + adj. + to V

1.explanation_zh: 「相較於真相」用 Compared with／to the truth（過去分詞片語；被比較的是後面主要子句的主詞 fake news）；主要子句用比較級 spreads much faster（much／far 加強比較級）。後半句「往往…就傳到成千上萬人」主詞同樣是假新聞，不另寫主詞與連接詞，用分詞構句 , often reaching thousands of people within a few hours。
evidence: 往往幾小時內就傳到成千上萬人
1.strategy_zh: 「相較於…」→ Compared with + N，主要子句記得用比較級；後半句同主詞、沒有連接詞 → 改成分詞。
hints: 切成四段：相較於真相／假新聞在社群媒體上傳得快多了／幾小時內／（往往）就傳到成千上萬人
標的詞彙：compare（比較）、truth（真相）、fake（假的）、spread（傳播）、social media（社群媒體）、hour（小時）、reach（傳到）、thousand（千）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + V + much + 比較級 …, often V-ing + O + within …

2.explanation_zh: 「轉傳資訊前先用批判性思考是很重要的」主詞是一整個動作，用虛主詞 It is important to use critical thinking before forwarding any information（before 後面接動名詞）。「因為…」用 because／since 子句；「誤導大眾」是 mislead the public。「引發恐慌」是假新聞誤導大眾造成的結果，用句尾分詞 , causing panic。
2.strategy_zh: 「做某事是很重要的」→ It is important to V；「…，引發／造成…」→ , causing + N。
hints: 切成四段：轉傳資訊前先用批判性思考／是很重要的／因為假新聞很容易誤導大眾／引發恐慌
標的詞彙：critical（批判性的）、forward（轉傳）、information（資訊）、fake（假的）、mislead（誤導）、public（大眾）、panic（恐慌）
句型框架：It is important to + V … before + V-ing …, because S + can + V …, causing + N

references: Compared with the truth, fake news spreads much faster on social media, often reaching thousands of people within a few hours.
Compared to the truth, fake news travels far more quickly on social media, often reaching tens of thousands of people within hours.
Compared with the truth, false news spreads much faster on social media, often reaching thousands of people in just a few hours.

patterns.label_zh: 相較於…（Compared with + N, S + V + 比較級）
patterns.frame: Compared with + N, S + V + much + 比較級 …

patterns.label_zh: 分詞構句（句尾分詞片語補充同一主詞的動作）
patterns.zh_trigger: 往往幾小時內就傳到成千上萬人

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用過去分詞 Compared with／to（＝When it is compared with …），不用原形 Compare。
假新聞是「被拿來比較」的一方，用 compared；comparing 表示主詞主動去比較。

parts.zh: 假新聞在社群媒體上傳得快多了
accepted: fake news spreads much faster on social media
fake news travels far more quickly on social media
false news spreads much faster on social media

common_errors.wrong: fake news spreads more faster on social media
common_errors.right: fake news spreads much faster on social media
common_errors.explanation_zh: faster 已經是比較級，不可再加 more；加強語氣用 much／far。

common_errors.wrong: fake news spread much faster on social media
common_errors.right: fake news spreads much faster on social media
common_errors.explanation_zh: news 是不可數名詞，視為單數，動詞加 s。
a few 是「幾個」，few 是「幾乎沒有」，意思不同。

accepted: often reaching tens of thousands of people
often spreading to thousands of people

common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後補充同一主詞的另一個動作要用分詞 reaching；寫 reaches 會變成兩個動詞沒有連接（要用 and）。
「成千上萬」是 thousands of，thousand 要加 s。

traps.literal_error: …, often reaching thousand and ten thousand people within a few hours.
traps.explanation_zh: 「成千上萬」是慣用說法，英文用 thousands (of people) 或 tens of thousands；不要逐字寫 thousand and ten thousand。

traps.literal_error: Compare with the truth, fake news spreads much faster …
traps.explanation_zh: 「相較於…」英文用過去分詞片語 Compared with／to …；寫成原形 Compare 會變成祈使句。

bonus.text: Compared with the truth, fake news spreads like wildfire on social media, often going viral within hours of being posted.
bonus.explanation_zh: spread like wildfire（像野火般蔓延）、go viral（瘋傳）、within hours of being posted（發布後幾小時內）更生動。

1.restructuring_zh: 後半句「往往幾小時內就傳到…」中文沒有主詞，英文不要再寫 it reaches，改成分詞構句 often reaching thousands of people，並把「幾小時內」移到句尾 within a few hours。

references: It is important to use critical thinking before forwarding any information, because fake news can easily mislead the public, causing panic.
It is important to think critically before passing on any information, since fake news can easily mislead the public, causing panic.
It is essential to apply critical thinking before sharing information, because fake news can easily mislead the public, leading to panic.

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞
patterns.frame: It is + adj. + to + V … before + V-ing …

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（引發…）

parts.zh: 轉傳資訊前先用批判性思考
accepted: to use critical thinking before forwarding any information
to think critically before passing on any information
to apply critical thinking before sharing information
to use critical thinking before sharing any information

common_errors.wrong: to use critical thinking before forward any information
common_errors.right: to use critical thinking before forwarding any information
common_errors.explanation_zh: 介系詞 before 後面接動名詞 forwarding。
「批判性的」是形容詞 critical；criticize 是動詞「批評」。

common_errors.wrong: Use critical thinking before forwarding any information is important
common_errors.right: It is important to use critical thinking before forwarding any information
common_errors.explanation_zh: 原形動詞片語不能當主詞；用虛主詞 It is important to …（或動名詞 Using … is important）。

common_errors.wrong: It is important that use critical thinking
common_errors.right: It is important to use critical thinking
common_errors.explanation_zh: It is + 形容詞後面接 to V；that 後面要接完整子句。

parts.zh: 因為假新聞很容易誤導大眾
accepted: because fake news can easily mislead the public
since fake news can easily mislead the public
as fake news can easily mislead the public
because fake news easily misleads the public

common_errors.wrong: because fake news can easily misleading the public
common_errors.right: because fake news can easily mislead the public
common_errors.explanation_zh: 助動詞 can 後面接原形動詞 mislead。

common_errors.wrong: because fake news can easily mislead the mass
common_errors.right: because fake news can easily mislead the public
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「大眾」用 the public；mass 是「大量、團塊」，指群眾要用 the masses。
逗號後表結果用現在分詞 causing；caused 會變成另一個過去式動詞，和前面接不起來。
panic 指恐慌的情緒時是不可數名詞，不加 s。

traps.literal_error: It is important to use critical think before forwarding any information, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「批判性思考」是名詞片語 critical thinking（或副詞寫法 think critically）；think 是動詞，不能接在 use critical 後面。

traps.zh: 轉傳資訊前先用批判性思考是很重要的
traps.literal_error: Use critical thinking before forwarding any information is very important, because …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿動作當主詞；英文用虛主詞 It is important to …，把動作移到後面。

bonus.text: It cannot be stressed enough how important it is to think critically before passing anything on, as fake news can easily mislead the public, sparking widespread panic.
bonus.explanation_zh: It cannot be stressed enough …（再怎麼強調也不為過）加強語氣，spark widespread panic（引發大規模恐慌）更生動。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文主詞「轉傳資訊前先用批判性思考」很長，英文用虛主詞 It is important to … 開頭，把動作移到後面；句尾「引發恐慌」不另起子句，用分詞 causing panic。

1.translation: Fake news spreads much faster than the truth on social media, often reaching thousands of people within just a few hours.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於真相，……快多了」英文最自然是比較級 much faster than the truth（也可寫 Compared with the truth, ... much faster）；「往往幾小時內就傳到……」是附帶結果，用句尾分詞 often reaching；「成千上萬人」譯 thousands of people。

2.translation: It is important to use critical thinking before forwarding information, because fake news can easily mislead the public and cause panic.
2.explanation_zh: 「轉傳資訊前先用批判性思考是很重要的」用虛主詞 It is important to；「轉傳前」用 before + V-ing；「因為」用 because 子句；「誤導大眾，引發恐慌」用對等動詞 mislead the public and cause panic。

issues_zh: 盲譯時「相較於真相，……快多了」自然寫成比較級 much faster than the truth，沒有用 Compared with + N（所以沒用到標的詞彙 compare）；我列 COMP 是因為譯文仍是比較句構，但不是 gp-compared-with 的框架。句尾分詞 often reaching thousands of people 有自然用到（PART）。
第 1 部分「相較於真相」單獨占 1 分，accepted 只收 Compared with/to／In comparison with；寫成更道地的 than the truth 的學生第 1 部分會被扣分，建議第 1 部分補「than the truth」，或把「相較於真相」與「快多了」併成同一部分。
盲譯時「誤導大眾，引發恐慌」自然寫成對等動詞 mislead the public and cause panic，沒有用句尾分詞 causing panic（PART）：中文的逗號並列同樣引出對等動詞。
第 4 部分 accepted 只收分詞 causing／leading to／triggering／creating panic，沒收同樣正確的「and cause panic」「and lead to panic」，應補進。

1.translation: Compared with the truth, fake news spreads much faster on social media, often reaching thousands of people within a few hours.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用 compared with；「快多了」用 much faster 表示差距；「往往幾小時內就傳到成千上萬人」用現在分詞片語 often reaching … 表示伴隨結果，時間用 within a few hours。

2.translation: It is important to think critically before forwarding information, because fake news can easily mislead the public and cause panic.
2.explanation_zh: 「……是很重要的」用虛主詞 it is important to；「批判性思考」用 think critically；「轉傳資訊前」用 before + V-ing；「很容易誤導大眾，引發恐慌」用 can easily mislead the public and cause panic。

issues_zh: 我把「誤導大眾，引發恐慌」譯成並列動詞 mislead the public and cause panic，自然又正確；但第 4 部分只收 causing／leading to／triggering／creating 的分詞片語，中文是兩個動作並列、沒有強制分詞構句，標的句型 PART 沒有被引出。建議 accepted 補上 and cause／and lead to panic，或移除 PART 標的。
